posts.title: stupid inconsequential things that annoy me
posts.description: When the first letter of someone's name is used in a blog post to protect their identity. I think it's because it feels like I'm reading something I'm not supposed to. I'd rather they say "my friend" instead of "B," as in, "hung out with my friend" instead of "hung out with B." That being said, I've definitely done this in the past 🤭 if not on this blog, then on Livejournal. It's just so ominous..
